integrity: The all-size result has an algebraic proof; finite numerical resolvents and rational identities are corroboration only. No independent audit or external certification.
limitations: Adjacency Hamiltonian, uniform site pure dephasing, fixed localized initial state, signed centered integrated return only. Not a graph-Laplacian result for unbalanced bicliques or an absolute-distance mixing metric. Earlier implicit prior derivations cannot be excluded.
title: Exact noise-optimal centered return integrals for Haken–Strobl walks on complete bipartite graphs
